description: Returns Docteur Bet's public track record: every value bet published before kick-off and then settled, wins and losses, with the number of bets, average odds and yield for each country's bookmaker market. These value bets come from the Docteur Bet model, Docteur Bet's own model for app subscribers (not the free Dixon-Coles model); the individual bets are subscriber-only and are not returned.

lang.description: Language of the summary and notices: "en" or "fr".

name: get_track_record
title: Track record
